description: Add-on for Node.js repos (use together with renovate/default). Repos that set enabledManagers must include "nvm" for the .nvmrc part.

packageRules.description: The Node.js version in .nvmrc (read by CI via setup-node's node-version-file) and the node base image in Dockerfiles move together. Also catches node-version inputs still hard-coded in workflows.
